set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- DType formats logical values for previews, diagnostics, errors, and examples.
- UInt8 255 and high UInt16 values render as unsigned magnitudes.
- Scalar equality, inequality, and ordered comparisons do not allocate temporary scalar NDArrays.
- Scalar-left arithmetic and comparisons are available where mathematically meaningful.
- The unary plus copy policy is explicitly documented and tested.
- Public syntax and overloads compile on Scala 3.7.4 without weakening rank inference.
- Allocation evidence covers the scalar paths promised for 1.0.
set.title: Finalize scalar and dtype presentation ergonomics before freeze
